window_policy.used: M5-News recommended defaults for A/B data and speeches; tool C default 5/15 kept for monitor-only events. tools/news_windows.py event defaults are A/B/C 5/15 and A-FOMC 15/45; those 5-minute lead-ins were not used for A or B prints or speeches.
window_policy.tool_defaults: A 5/15 block; A FOMC 15/45 block; B 5/15 caution; C 5/15 monitor. now exits 1 only on an active A block.
window_policy.A_fomc: 30 minutes before the statement to 60 minutes after the press conference start, including the presser. None in this date window.
window_policy.A_chair_speech: 15/30 hard block; extend through a scheduled Q&A or fireside segment.
window_policy.B_data: 15/15 caution + spread check (PPI, Retail Sales, jobless claims, UK CPI).
window_policy.B_speech_qa: 15/30 caution + spread check (governor/president outlook or Q&A).
window_policy.B_minutes: 15/15 caution; fomc=false so merge will not upgrade to A. Upgrade only if the preceding meeting is known to be contentious.
